Subject: Constitution of Disciplinary Committee.

This order supersedes all previous orders regarding the constitution of the Disciplinary Committee for the institution and shall come into immediate effect.

A new Disciplinary Committee is hereby constituted with immediate effect to maintain discipline, uphold institutional policies, and address matters of conduct involving both students and staff (teaching, non-teaching, and support staff).

The committee's members are as follows:

The committee shall function under the overall supervision of Mr. Yamin Kinah, Incharge Automobile Engg Department and shall be responsible for upholding and enforcing the institution's disciplinary policies and guidelines. This includes, but is not limited to:
* Addressing all matters related to student conduct (such as attendance, academic integrity, campus behavior, use of prohibited items, and adherence to rules).
* Addressing all matters related to staff conduct (teaching and non-teaching), including professionalism, punctuality, ethical behavior, and compliance with institutional/service rules.
* Investigating complaints, conducting inquiries (as per established procedures), and recommending appropriate actions (warnings, penalties, counselling, or escalation to higher authorities) to ensure a disciplined, respectful, safe, and orderly environment for all stakeholders.

The committee shall function under the overall supervision of the principal and may co-opt additional members or invite concerned parties for specific cases as required.

Order No: 05 of 2026
Dated: 03-04-2026

Subject: Internal Physical Verification of Stores, Library, Workshop and Departments/Sections.

In order to ensure proper upkeep, maintenance and physical verification of all assets, infrastructure, equipment, furniture, tools, machinery, records and other materials in the institution, all Heads of Departments (HoDs), Incharges and Sectional Heads are hereby directed to carry out a comprehensive internal physical verification of their respective departments/sections. The verification shall mandatorily include Stores (Main Store and departmental Stores), Library (books, journals, e-resources, furniture and fixtures), Workshop (tools, machinery, equipment and accessories), laboratories, furniture and fixtures, computers, printers and IT equipment, electrical and civil infrastructure, stock registers, dead stock items and all other movable or immovable assets under their control. All HoDs/Incharges shall personally supervise the verification process to ensure its completeness and accuracy. The detailed report of the internal physical verification, duly signed by the concerned HoD/Incharge, along with list of discrepancies (if any), shortage/excess report and recommendations for rectification, shall be submitted to the undersigned on or before 30th April 2026.

After completion of the internal physical verification by all departments/sections, the Inter-Departmental Physical Verification will commence and the schedule along with constitution of the Inter-Departmental Verification Teams shall be notified separately. Strict compliance of this order is expected from all concerned.

SUBJECT: Establishment of Facilitation Centre for Online Admission Forms of Three-Year Diploma Programme.

It is notified for the information of all concerned that the admission process for the Three-Year Diploma Programme has commenced from the Board of Technical Education (BOTE). A large number of students are visiting the institution for guidance regarding the submission of online admission forms.

In order to facilitate the students and to provide them proper guidance, it is hereby directed that a Facilitation Centre for filling of online admission forms shall be established in the Computer Department with immediate effect.

Further, Dr. Aejaz Farooq and Dr. Neelam Saleem Khan are hereby nominated as Facilitators for the said centre. They shall help and guide the students in filling up the online admission forms. The facilitators shall maintain a proper record/report of the students who visit the Facilitation Centre. The report should include the name of the student, parentage, contact number, course applied for, and any other relevant details.

This order shall come into force with immediate effect.
